title: WorldSharing
description: Sharing a world as one local file (F5234 C, A1354): the save game, the chronicle as a web page and a manifest in one zip. Nothing is sent anywhere; the player passes the file on. Files from others are untrusted: only the listed entries, size limits, a known format.

format.description: Format version written into the manifest; files of other formats are refused.

extension.description: File extension of a shared world.

max_save_bytes.description: Largest save game accepted from a shared file.

max_chronicle_bytes.description: Largest chronicle page accepted from a shared file.
